text: Train from any video: depth + flow estimation, pseudo-stereo, warp-back hole filling
description: Take unlabeled video and estimate per-frame depth (e.g. Video Depth Anything), optical flow (e.g. RAFT) and camera pose. Lift these to world-space scene flow, which gives the RGB/depth/velocity state. Synthesise the other eye by warping to an offset virtual camera. Then warp the virtual view back to the original: the original's holes come with ground truth, giving a supervised hole-filling signal (the cyclic-warp trick used by InfiniteNature-Zero and single-view view-synthesis work). Temporal pairs give a reprojection-with-motion signal. Complements the data-free SDF teacher.

status.comment: train/ pipeline (commit eb0b9d7): frames.sh, prepare.py (Depth Anything V2 Small at 252, RAFT small at 256, robust reprojection camera fit with translation prior, object velocity as residual flow), train.py real-loop rollouts t->t+1 with observe blend. Warp-back and pseudo-stereo not done yet.
